notes.subject: קנה/קנינך
notes.rationale: roots-a-tḥata go tšwa go קנה go ntha ka go boela — the sound-pun on קנה and קנין

notes.subject: ראשית חכמה
notes.rationale: ka ke go hloka se sengwe: 'go thoma ga khokagano' goba 'thušo ya go thoma ga khokagano' goba 'khokagano ke yona thušo ya pele'

notes.subject: go kwešiša ka bobedi
notes.rationale: do-šomišwa mo go bontšha go boeletšwa ga taelo ka moka

translation: Thaologanyo ya khokagano: hwetša khokagano, gomme le se sengwe le se sengwe seo o se hwetšago, hwetša go kwešiša.

tokens.gloss: gomme le se sengwe le se sengwe
